USACE Rock Island District 'Along the River' 2024 Edition booklet (linked from the district's Camping page, Wayback capture 2025-02-02 of https://www.mvr.usace.army.mil/missions/recreation/mississippi-river-project/recreation/camping/), PDF read from Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20250202045620/https://usace.contentdm.oclc.org/utils/getfile/collection/p16021coll11/id/6905 (the live USACE digital-library link answers a Cloudflare challenge, not solved): p.6 Recreation Areas table row '21. Esri World_Imagery (40.1125,-91.4818, 180 m half-width and 600 m half-width, read 2026-11-20): gravel campground road running N-S along the east bank of a ~140 m wide Mississippi side channel; road 20-50 m from the water behind a broken fringe of trees, open grass to the water by the boat ramp at ~40.1118,-91.4826; loop centroid ~40.1122,-91.4816 (~130 m WNW of the pin - no move)
recreation.gov: no campground facility for Bear Creek (p3-476 search; RIDB 247950 is a stub)

fees.source: https://web.archive.org/web/20250310171033/https://www.mvr.usace.army.mil/Missions/Recreation/Mississippi-River-Project/Recreation/Bear-Creek/ (USACE page captured 2025-03-10): 'primitive camping as well as boat ramp river access that are both free for public use'; the 2024 Along the River table shows no Camping Fee

sites.source: USACE 'Along the River' 2024 Edition p.6 (Wayback 20250202045620 of usace.contentdm.oclc.org/utils/getfile/collection/p16021coll11/id/6905): Bear Creek 18 camping sites

note: USACE campground on offshoot of Mississippi River. Primitive riverside sites: fire rings, trash service, cement boat ramp. Level, shaded gravel sites usable by RVs. On the riverside of the levee and flood-prone -- in spring call to confirm it isn't underwater. Warning: Google Maps misroutes ~4 mi south). --AWH
summary: Corps page still Akamai-walled to the headless browser; read via Wayback (page 2025-03-10, 2024 Along the River booklet). Confirmed free, FCFS-only primitive camping, no hookups/water/showers, vault toilets; added 18 sites, flush_toilets/dump false. AWH riverfront agrees with imagery (gravel road on the bank of a ~140 m side channel). Pin OK. Season not stated by any official page.
flags: WATERFRONT (--AWH riverfront, unchanged): imagery agrees - the campground road runs along the east bank of a ~140 m wide Mississippi side channel (riverfront width, not creekside), 20-50 m from the water behind a broken tree fringe, with open grass to the water at the boat ramp (~40.1118,-91.4826). Individual site posts are not identifiable on imagery, so no site numbers can be given.

PHONE: stored '563-263-7913,217-228-0890'. The Corps page (captured 2025-03-10) gives only the Muscatine Ranger Office 563-263-7913; 217-228-0890 is not on any page read (it may be the Lock & Dam 21 office). Suggest 563-263-7913 alone unless the second number is known to answer for Bear Creek.

WEBSITE: https://www.mvr.usace.army.mil/Missions/Recreation/Mississippi-River-Project/Recreation/Bear-Creek/ kept (the Corps' own page; it refuses bots, but the newest Wayback capture 2025-03-10 shows it current). SEASON: no official statement. The booklet's Class A season (May 1 - 4th Sunday in October) is for the reservable parks only; Good Sam's 'open all year' is a directory claim. Left unset.
STATUS: no current notice found (the live status page is gone); the stored --AWH flood caveat stays.
